home.kicker: A research demo, built to be honest about its limits
home.title: Understand what a breast cancer risk model can — and can't — tell you
home.body: Hope Gate pairs a transparent demo classifier with a directory of oncology centers across Egypt's governorates. Every result here comes from cell-measurement data collected after imaging or biopsy — it is not an early-screening tool, and it is not a substitute for a doctor.

disclaimer.model: This is a research demo trained on a public dataset of post-biopsy cell measurements. It is not a clinical device, has not been validated on Egyptian patients, and cannot assess risk before a diagnostic workup has happened. Always rely on a qualified doctor.

predict.title: Demo classifier
predict.intro: Enter the eight cell-measurement values from a pathology report to see how the demo model scores them. This does not replace a doctor's reading.

intake.title: Patient intake
intake.intro: Share a few details and we'll point you to a listed oncology center in your governorate. Nothing here is diagnostic.
intake.family_history: First-degree family history of breast cancer
intake.consent: I consent to this information being stored so a center can be recommended to me.
intake.success: Saved. Suggested center for your governorate:

hospitals.title: Oncology centers by governorate
hospitals.intro: Directory information only — not a referral or a quality ranking. Confirm address, services, and hours before visiting.

batch.title: Batch prediction
batch.intro: Upload a CSV with the eight core measurement columns to score multiple rows at once.
